text:
incident-bot: PAGE P0 -> elevated 5xx spike observed from edge-proxy -> runtime-api. Auto-run diagnostics kicked off, paging oncall. Link: https://pager.redwood.example/p/1994024567 :rotating_light:

alice: taking pager, jumping in. Anyone see errors in traces yet?

bob: I see a surge of 502/504s hitting edge-proxy starting ~03:07 UTC. Lots of upstream timeouts, then retries. grabbing sample traces.

carol: chiming in — oncall notes from runbook: try quick mitigation (disable client retries at LB / fallback to small model pool) while we gather logs. Can @fiona do a fast scale of proxy?

fiona: scaling now -> `kubectl scale deploy edge-proxy -n prod --replicas=12` (was 4). rolling update in progress. ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: rolling update started for deploy/edge-proxy (rev: 2026-03-15T03:08Z) by fiona.

alice: mitigation 1: scale up proxied pool (fiona), mitigation 2: disable 3rd-party client retries at LB (carol/dave), mitigation 3: route small-model-variants (bob)

dave: disabling client retry header at LB now: `curl -X POST https://lb.api/config -d '{"retries":0,"routeFallback":"enabled"}'` -> applied.

eve: support report incoming — a couple enterprise customers reported intermittent 502s in EU region. Customer impact estimate: ~0.7% of traffic, small percent of requests retried by clients.

bob: pasted a sample trace/log (redacted):
```
time=2026-03-15T03:07:22Z level=error svc=edge-proxy upstream=runtime-api status=504 dur_ms=5200 corr_id=rb-5a3f9c trace=5a3f9c1fefce
time=2026-03-15T03:07:23Z level=info svc=edge-proxy retry=1 upstream=runtime-api status=504 corr_id=rb-5a3f9c
time=2026-03-15T03:07:25Z level=error svc=runtime-api msg="batch handler timeout" dur_ms=4800 node=gpu-23 corr_id=rb-5a3f9c
```

carol: thanks. correlation id pattern `rb-5a3f*` repeating a lot. Pulling spans in observability for last 30m: query `service:edge-proxy AND status:[500 TO 599] AND correlation_id:rb-*`

alice: quick timeline draft:
- 03:06:50 UTC: small traffic spike from partner X (burst of long-sequence requests)
- 03:07:10 UTC: edge-proxy begins to surface 504s to clients
- 03:07:20-03:09:00 UTC: retries observed, some amplification on runtime-api
- 03:09:30 UTC: fiona scaled edge-proxy; dave disabled LB retries; bob routed a subset to small-model pool
- 03:12:00 UTC: error rate falling but still above baseline; running post-mitigation checks

bob: hypothesis A: a burst of long-sequence requests overloaded a subset of runtime GPU nodes, causing slow responses -> client retries amplified load and starved other nodes.

bob: hypothesis B: a recently rolled runtime release added a blocking sync path in batch handler under certain inputs (seen `batch handler timeout`) causing higher p99 processing time.

carol: data needed: 1) runtime worker logs for nodes reporting `batch handler timeout` (node ids: gpu-23, gpu-19, gpu-21) 2) trace list for corr_ids `rb-5a3f*` 3) LB metric of retry counts per minute 4) model input sizes distribution for 02:55-03:15 UTC

alice: can folks paste the obs queries we should run? I'll collect and attach to the RCA thread.

bob: obs queries:
- Kibana: `@timestamp:[2026-03-15T03:00 TO 2026-03-15T03:20] AND correlation_id:rb-* AND service:runtime-api`
- Traces: `trace.tag.correlation_id:rb-* | top by duration`
- Prom: `sum(rate(edge_proxy_5xx_total[1m])) by (region)`

fiona: grabbing node logs now from GCS bucket `gs://redwood-prod-logs/runtime/gpu-23/2026-03-15/03` -> sharing presigned link shortly.

eve: posted customer-impact notes to internal ticket RED-873: customer list + timestamps + contact reps.

bob: quick grep output (redacted) showing repeated retry loop on client side (window shortened):
```
[03:07:21] request id=rb-5a3f9c attempts=1
[03:07:22] request id=rb-5a3f9c upstream_timeout
[03:07:23] client retry attempt=1 id=rb-5a3f9c
[03:07:23] request id=rb-5a3f9c attempts=2 upstream_timeout
```

carol: see pattern where clients retry within 1s, creating hot loops. mitigation to disable retries at LB seems to have cut amplification. Can we blacklist that partner X burst for 10m?

alice: agreed. dave, can you coordinate with Traffic Control to throttle partner X traffic for 10m?

dave: on it. throttle rule applied for partner X (id: partner-88) -> 10m window.

bob: dev note: runtime team will revert last non-critical change that touched batching if logs corroborate hypothesis B. filing a PR revert candidate.

carol: for RCA we should capture: peak 5xx/min, retry amplification factor (requests->upstream attempts), affected customers, and root cause hypothesis with evidence.

alice: collecting artifacts:
- edge-proxy logs link: https://logs.redwood.example/edge-proxy?from=2026-03-15T03:00&to=2026-03-15T03:20
- runtime node logs (gpu-23): https://storage.redwood.example/gpu-23/2026-03-15/03/log.txt?sig=...
- trace sample list: `rb-5a3f9c, rb-6b2d1a, rb-7f4d88`

fiona: confirm: no deploys happened to runtime-api in the 1h before incident (checked gitops). last runtime deploy 2026-03-15T01:09Z.

bob: running deeper perf profile on gpu-23 logs; initial look shows batch handler queueing latency spike at 03:06:58 with p95 ~4.6s.

eve: customer comms draft: "We saw an elevated 5xx rate originating from request retries with partner bursts; mitigations applied at 03:12 UTC, error rate returned to baseline by 03:14 UTC. We are investigating root cause and will follow up." sending to affected reps.

alice: next actions (on-incident):
- bob: collect runtime logs + correlation traces and post in RCA doc (within 1h)
- carol: compute amplification factor and prom graphs (30m window)
- fiona: validate scale change and LB config rollback safety
- dave: confirm partner-throttle metrics and customer comms sent
- eve: update ticket with customer impact details

bob: uploaded runtime logs snippet to RCA doc. link: https://docs.redwood.example/rca/1994024567/logs

carol: initial amplification calc: baseline requests 150rps -> 03:07 spike 200rps with retry factor ~1.9 leading to ~380 upstream attempts/minute on small node subset. attaching graph.

alice: marking this thread as in-incident RCA coordination. We'll keep thread open while we collect evidence. If anyone finds smoking-gun trace, paste it here. :mag: 

deploy-bot: rolling update for edge-proxy completed at 03:11:35Z (12 replicas healthy).

fiona: cluster metrics look stable now; no further 5xx spike in last 10m.

alice: handing off to post-incident RCA leads: bob (runtime) and carol (sre). I'll reassign paging to the regular oncall after 60m. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
